ui.title: Escalafón
ui.subtitle: Rung 6: Mayor of Villanueva
ui.tagline: Kingdom of Hesperia. One four-year term. The best of intentions.
ui.name: Your name
ui.causes_hint: Pick three. They are your legacy and your excuse.
ui.help: Drag to pan. Scroll to zoom. Click a staked plot to build. Space pauses.
meter.power.hint: Your weight in the party. At zero, they expel you.
meter.image.hint: What Villanueva thinks of you. The basis of the vote.
meter.budget.hint: The town's coffers. In the red, someone takes over.
meter.blackMoney.hint: The off-books stash. Whatever you don't launder heats up Suspicion every month.
meter.suspicion.hint: At 100, indictment. Drops one point a month if you behave.
meter.compass.hint: From Upright to Cynical. Changes how you justify yourself.
compass.tier1: If I don't, someone worse will.
party.orden.name: Conservatives of Order
party.orden.desc: Landlords, the self-employed, pensioners and hoteliers love you. Everyone else puts up with you.
party.progreso.name: United Progressives
party.progreso.desc: Tenants, the young, migrant workers and environmentalists love you. Everyone else keeps an eye on you.
cause.vivienda.name: Affordable housing
cause.vivienda.desc: A normal wage should pay a normal rent.
cause.impuestos.name: Lower local taxes
cause.impuestos.desc: The property tax bill should stop being scary.
cause.agua.name: Water for the fields
cause.agua.desc: The farmland shouldn't depend on prayers for rain.
cause.empleo.name: Industrial jobs
cause.empleo.desc: Payslips, warehouses and young people who stay.
cause.sanidad.name: Neighbourhood healthcare
cause.sanidad.desc: A doctor who knows your name.
cause.paisaje.name: Protected landscape
char.cunado.name: Fermín
char.jefa_gabinete.name: Marisa Oñate
char.concejal_urbanismo.name: Tomás Rebollo
char.constructor.name: Anselmo Pórtico
char.constructor.role: Pórtico Construction. Always on time, if you're the one calling.
char.tesorero.name: Baltasar Ugarte
char.tesorero.role: Party treasurer. Never asks, always writes it down.
char.interventora.name: Remedios Galván
char.interventora.role: Municipal comptroller. Reads the fine print.
building.vivienda_protegida.name: Social housing
building.vivienda_protegida.desc: 120 flats at regulated prices. Landlords call it unfair competition.
building.bloque_libre.name: Market-rate housing block
building.bloque_libre.desc: 200 flats at market price. The market is delighted.
building.hotel.name: Hotel
building.hotel.desc: Four stars and a view of the sewage plant, if you build one.
building.pisos_turisticos.name: Holiday flats
building.pisos_turisticos.desc: Neighbours used to live here. Now suitcases do.
building.polideportivo.name: Sports centre
building.polideportivo.desc: Court, stands and a plaque with your name.
building.centro_salud.name: Health centre
building.depuradora.name: Water treatment plant
building.depuradora.desc: Nobody opens it. Everybody uses it.
building.poligono_industrial.name: Industrial estate
building.regadio.name: Irrigation
building.regadio.desc: Water for the farmland. Environmentalists count the litres.
building.parque.name: Park
build.empty: Vacant plot. What shall we put up?
build.clean_hint: Slow and pricey. Nobody will subpoena you.
build.dedo_hint: Fast. Pórtico says thanks with {amount} in an envelope.
build.none_here: None of the catalogue buildings fit this land.
loyalty.shield: Would take the fall for you
decree.limitar_pisos.name: Cap holiday flats
decree.limitar_pisos.desc: One licence per doorway. The suitcases protest.
decree.tasa_turistica.name: Tourist tax
decree.tasa_turistica.desc: One coin per night. The tourism sector asks for the complaints book.
decree.bonificar_autonomos.name: Relief for the self-employed
decree.bonificar_autonomos.desc: Lower fees for whoever lifts the shutter every morning.
decree.subir_ibi.name: Raise property tax
decree.subir_ibi.desc: Raises a lot. Every letterbox notices.
decree.zona_verde.name: Expand green zones
decree.regularizacion.name: Regularisation plan
decree.regularizacion.desc: Papers for people who already work here.
caja.launder_hint: Up to {amount} through Fermín's consultancy. He keeps {fee}%.
caja.fund_hint: {cost}. +{power} Power. The treasurer writes it down.
caja.empty: The stash is empty. For now.
press.name: The Villanueva Echo
press.motto: The town's paper of record since 1911
press.calm: Villanueva celebrates a month without news
press.filler.1: Mayor visits works in hard hat and smile
press.filler.2: Unanswered questions at the last council meeting
press.filler.5: Town hall sources: «Nothing to see here»
press.filler.6: Civic Guard requests documents from the town hall
press.lorem: This paper has learned that several municipal files show dates, signatures and figures that do not quite add up. The town hall declined to comment.
log.leak: {who} has talked. The Echo runs a {crime} story.
log.shield: {who} takes all the blame and vanishes from your life. Exemplary loyalty.
log.journalist_bribe: Lucía Ferrán takes a very long holiday.
log.journalist_clean: Lucía Ferrán finds nothing. She writes about pigeons.
log.audit_clean: The audit comes back clean. Even you are surprised.
log.launder: Laundered {amount}. The consultancy bills it as «strategic advice».
log.fund_party: The party thanks you for your anonymous donation. Very anonymous.
log.campaign: Banners with your face appear. Nobody knows who paid.
event.sequia.name: Drought
event.tipos.name: Rate hike
event.tipos.desc: The Central Bank of Hesperia makes money dearer. And mortgages.
event.fabrica.name: Cannery shuts down
event.turismo_record.name: Record tourist season
ending.reeleccion_limpia.headline: {name} re-elected mayor without a single wet paper
ending.reeleccion_limpia.body: Four years of public tenders, endless deadlines and not one front page. Rivals call the mayor boring. The mayor takes it as a compliment.
ending.reeleccion_rastro.headline: {name} sweeps the polls. The courts take note too
ending.reeleccion_rastro.body: Voters reward finished works. The courts, slower, also have a memory. Party sources speak of «a solid project».
ending.derrota.headline: Villanueva changes mayor: {name} bows out
ending.derrota.body: The outgoing mayor blames «a climate of tension». The successor promises audits. Everyone promises audits.
ending.imputacion.headline: Judge charges {name}
ending.imputacion.headline_fraude: Judge charges {name} over the postal vote
ending.imputacion.body: Civic Guard officers left the town hall with eleven boxes and a ficus. The lawyer insists «everything is in order, except what isn't».
ending.expulsion.headline: Party expels {name}: «Does not represent our values»
ending.expulsion.body: The disciplinary committee took six minutes. The seventh was spent deleting photos.
ending.cabeza_turco.headline: Party hands over {name}: «One bad apple doesn't spoil the barrel»
ending.cabeza_turco.body: The leadership insists the mayor acted alone. Sources in the leadership insist the same, more quietly.
ending.arrepentido.headline: {name} spills everything to the prosecutor
ending.arrepentido.body: The statement runs to four hundred pages and splashes half the party. Says sleep comes easier now. Fermín's, less so.
front.legacy.agua: Brought water to {n} hectares of farmland.
front.trail.0: Did not leave a single invoice unsigned.
front.trail.few: It cost {n} crimes and a few awkward dinners with the brother-in-law.
front.trail.one: It cost one crime and a few awkward dinners with the brother-in-law.
front.trail.many: It cost {n} crimes and the trust of those who voted for it.
front.shield: {n} aides took the blame for someone else.
front.no_vote: Never made it to the polls
exp.vega_1.title: A bargain plot
exp.vega_1.body: Your brother-in-law Fermín has spotted a rural plot in La Vega. «It's dirt cheap. If it ever gets rezoned, just imagine.» He winks. You are the one who rezones.
exp.vega_1.a: Let him buy it. In his name, of course.
exp.vega_1.b: Don't even think about it, Fermín.
exp.vega_2.title: La Vega goes to council
exp.vega_2.body: Tomás Rebollo brings the rezoning of La Vega to council. «Public interest», says the report. Fermín's interest is also fairly public.
exp.vega_2.c: Rezone and expropriate at assessed value for social housing.
exp.vega_3.title: The split
exp.vega_3.body: Pórtico Construction will build homes in La Vega. The capital gain is about two million. Fermín proposes «a family split»: him, Pórtico, the party and you.
exp.vega_3.a: A quarter each. And some social units, for the photo.
exp.vega_3.b: All social housing, and the gain goes to the town.
exp.vega_4.title: The champagne SUV
exp.vega_4.body: Fermín has bought a champagne-coloured SUV and parks it in the town hall square. Double-parked. Engine running.
exp.vega_4.a: Make him return it. Or hide it.
exp.vega_4.b: It's his money. Let him enjoy it.
exp.viv_cooperativa.title: The co-op
exp.viv_cooperativa.body: A tenants' cooperative asks for a municipal plot for 40 homes. They have an architect, plans and admirable patience.
exp.viv_cooperativa.a: Hand over the plot and service it.
exp.viv_cooperativa.b: Hand it over and let Pórtico service it. Fast and grateful.
exp.viv_fondo.title: Hespérides Capital
exp.viv_fondo.body: An investment fund has kept a whole block empty for six years. Local tenants have several names for the fund. None printable.
exp.viv_fondo.c: Accept their invitation to a conference at a spa.
exp.imp_contable.title: Creative accounting
exp.imp_contable.body: An outside adviser proposes cutting property tax without cutting anything else. «It's just moving lines around», he explains, moving his hands a lot. The comptroller frowns.
exp.imp_contable.b: Cut a little, with real cuts.
exp.imp_agujero.title: The hole
exp.imp_agujero.body: A hole has appeared in the town accounts. Nobody knows how. Well, somebody does.
exp.imp_rebaja.title: There's money left over
exp.imp_rebaja.body: The books balance and there's a surplus. The finance office asks what to do with it, in a tone suggesting the right answer is «nothing».
exp.imp_rebaja.b: Save it for a rainy day.
exp.imp_terrazas.title: The terrace fee
exp.imp_terrazas.body: The hospitality association wants the terrace fee scrapped. In return they promise nicer chairs.
exp.imp_terrazas.b: Scrap it only on your street.
exp.agua_pozos.title: Undocumented wells
exp.agua_pozos.body: Forty farmers irrigate with illegal wells that drain the aquifer. They all voted for you. Some of them twice.
exp.agua_pozos.a: Legalise them in exchange for a fee.
exp.agua_pozos.c: Look the other way in exchange for a donation.
exp.agua_trasvase.title: The water transfer
exp.agua_trasvase.body: The provincial council offers a water transfer for the farmland if your group backs its budget. The budget includes an airport with no planes.
exp.agua_golf.title: Water for golf
exp.agua_golf.body: Tomás Rebollo asks for canal water for his cousin's golf course. «Golf is countryside too», he argues.
exp.agua_golf.b: Let him water it with tears.
exp.emp_bateria.title: Voltaria
exp.emp_bateria.body: A battery factory wants to set up in Villanueva. 180 jobs. They want free land and, in a low voice, «a gesture of goodwill».
exp.emp_bateria.b: Accept, but the gesture goes your way.
exp.emp_plan.title: Jobs scheme
exp.emp_plan.body: A municipal scheme to hire 60 unemployed people for a year. They will paint benches, trim hedges and wish the year were longer.
exp.emp_plan.a: Hire by lottery among the unemployed.
exp.emp_plan.c: Wait for the market to regulate itself.
exp.san_tardes.title: Afternoon clinic
exp.san_tardes.body: The clinic closes at three. In the afternoon, residents fall ill in the next town over.
exp.san_tardes.b: Contract the clinic of a friend of the treasurer.
exp.san_lista.title: Your mother's neighbour
exp.san_lista.body: Your mother's neighbour needs a knee operation and has been on the waiting list for eight months. Your mother looks at you.
exp.san_lista.b: Explain that there is a list.
exp.san_ambulancia.title: Ambulance or street party
exp.san_ambulancia.body: The leftover budget pays for a new ambulance or the August street party. The party has more voters.
exp.paisaje_eolico.title: Windmills on the ridge
exp.paisaje_eolico.body: A company wants twenty wind turbines on the ridge. Money, jobs and a view that will never be the same.
exp.paisaje_eolico.b: Reject and declare the ridge a protected area.
exp.paisaje_eolico.c: Approve if they sponsor your foundation.
exp.paisaje_chalet.title: The councillor's villa
exp.paisaje_chalet.body: Tomás Rebollo has a villa in a protected area. It appears on no map. It has a pool.
exp.paisaje_romano.title: Roman remains
exp.paisaje_romano.body: The diggers have found a Roman mosaic. Pórtico asks whether anyone saw anything. Nobody has seen anything, so far.
exp.paisaje_romano.c: Turn it into a museum, with a bar.
exp.hotel_plantas.title: Three more floors
exp.hotel_plantas.body: The hotel wants three more floors. «For the views», says the manager. He adds that the presidential suite could bear your name.
exp.hotel_plantas.a: Grant it, with licence and fees.
exp.hotel_plantas.b: Grant it in exchange for the suite. For life.
exp.pisos_maletas.title: The five a.m. suitcases
exp.pisos_maletas.body: Residents of Main Street complain about suitcase wheels at five in the morning. They have a forty-minute recording.
exp.pisos_maletas.b: Hand out earplugs with the town crest.
exp.poli_cinta.title: Who cuts the ribbon?
exp.poli_cinta.body: The sports centre opens. There's a ribbon, some scissors and three candidates.
exp.depu_sobrecoste.title: Cost overrun
exp.depu_sobrecoste.body: The treatment plant will cost 40% more. Pórtico blames «geological surprises». The rock has been there since the Jurassic.
exp.depu_sobrecoste.b: Amend the contract, no questions asked.
exp.regadio_turno.title: Watering rota
exp.regadio_turno.body: The irrigation rota needs setting. The farmers bring a list. Oddly, it matches the party membership roll.
exp.regadio_turno.b: Those who voted right go first.
exp.salud_nombre.title: Naming the health centre
exp.salud_nombre.body: The health centre needs a name. The plaque has been ordered. Only the text is missing.
exp.salud_nombre.a: Dr Ezequiel Lobo, country doctor for forty years.
exp.salud_nombre.b: Yours. A tribute while you're alive.
exp.poligono_naves.title: A warehouse, please
exp.poligono_naves.body: A logistics firm wants a free municipal warehouse in exchange for 40 jobs. Tomás suggests «formalising the gratitude».
exp.poligono_naves.b: Hand it over and formalise the gratitude.
exp.vivienda_sorteo.title: The lottery
exp.vivienda_sorteo.body: Time to allocate the social housing. Three thousand applications. Marisa brings a short list of «special cases».
exp.vivienda_sorteo.b: Set some aside for Marisa's list.
exp.parque_estatua.title: The park statue
exp.parque_estatua.body: The park needs a statue. The town sculptor has ideas, bronze and little shame.
exp.parque_estatua.b: You, in bronze, pointing at the future.
exp.fiestas.title: Patron saint festival
exp.fiestas.body: The festival committee wants a headliner. The usual band or a pop star with a suspicious fee.
exp.fiestas.b: The pop star, with markup and commission.
exp.tesorero_campana.title: Voluntary contributions
exp.tesorero_campana.body: Baltasar Ugarte, the party treasurer, reminds you that campaigns don't pay for themselves. «Any contribution is welcome. Any.»
exp.tesorero_campana.a: Chip in from the slush fund.
exp.jefa_aumento.title: Marisa wants more
exp.jefa_aumento.body: Your chief of staff asks for a raise. She insists it is not a threat. She says so three times.
exp.jefa_aumento.a: Pay her through a fictitious consultancy.
exp.interventora_informe.title: Unfavourable report
exp.interventora_informe.body: Remedios Galván, the comptroller, issues an unfavourable report with twenty pages of annexes. Stapled with fury.
exp.padron.title: The census
exp.padron.body: Four hundred seasonal workers live in Villanueva without being registered. Fermín says forty fit in his flat, if they don't move much.
exp.rotonda.title: The roundabout
exp.rotonda.body: The south entrance needs a roundabout. Tomás suggests decorating it with a sculpture by his cousin, a conceptual artist.
exp.rotonda.c: No roundabout. Let the cars sort it out.
exp.mocion.title: Censure motion
exp.mocion.body: The opposition tables a motion censuring your management. It has no legal effect, but it has cameras.
exp.mocion.c: Call a press conference about the weather.
exp.fiscal.title: The prosecutor
exp.fiscal.body: An anti-corruption prosecutor summons you to a windowless office. «We know you're not the big fish. Help us with the big fish.»
exp.fiscal.b: I have no idea what you mean.
exp.partido_aviso.title: A call from headquarters
exp.partido_aviso.body: The party leadership asks for «discretion and a low profile». They say it in the tone of someone who has already printed another poster.
exp.campana.title: The campaign slogan
exp.campana.body: The agency proposes three slogans. All three fit on a lamppost.
exp.amano_correo.title: Postal vote
exp.amano_correo.body: A «courier company» offers to handle fifteen hundred postal votes. Delivery guaranteed. Sender not guaranteed.
exp.amano_correo.b: Better that everyone votes for themselves.
exp.amano_autobus.title: Pensioners' outing
exp.amano_autobus.body: Marisa organises a lunch for pensioners on the eve of the election. Coach, paella and, optionally, an envelope.
exp.cunado_consultora.title: Fermín's consultancy
exp.cunado_consultora.body: Fermín has set up a consultancy. He isn't quite sure what it does. He wants a few small contracts «to get going».
exp.cunado_consultora.a: Give him a few small contracts.
exp.auditoria.title: External audit
exp.auditoria.body: The opposition demands an external audit. You have an auditor, a free afternoon and a light cold sweat.
exp.farola.title: The lamppost on Elm Street
exp.farola.body: A resident asks for a lamppost. He has been asking for twenty years. He has brought a lamppost-shaped cake.
exp.huelga_basura.title: Bin strike
exp.huelga_basura.body: The refuse collectors go on strike. The square smells of collective bargaining.
exp.huelga_basura.c: Send the councillors out to collect it.
exp.crisis_sequia.title: Drought
exp.crisis_sequia.body: The river runs, embarrassed. Reservoirs are at 12%. The golf course is still green, mysteriously.
exp.crisis_tipos.title: Rates go up
exp.crisis_tipos.body: The Central Bank of Hesperia raises rates. The town loan now costs twice as much. The bank regrets it with a smile.
exp.crisis_tipos.c: Blame the Central Bank in a press release.
exp.crisis_fabrica.title: The cannery closes
exp.crisis_fabrica.body: The cannery shuts and lays off 150 people. The owner moves to an island named after a cocktail.
exp.crisis_fabrica.c: Buy the building and gift it to a friendly investor.
exp.crisis_turismo.title: Record season
exp.crisis_turismo.body: Record visitors. Queues at the bakery, the chemist and the cemetery, which now offers guided tours.
exp.crisis_turismo.b: Let terraces spill onto the road.
exp.crisis_turismo.c: Rent out the council chamber for weddings.
exp.periodista_1.title: Lucía Ferrán asks
exp.periodista_1.body: Lucía Ferrán of The Villanueva Echo wants an interview. She brings a notebook and specific questions, the worst thing a journalist can bring.
exp.periodista_1.c: Pull the town's advertising from the paper.
exp.periodista_2.title: Four columns wide
exp.periodista_2.body: The Echo leads with «The books that don't add up». Byline: Lucía Ferrán. The market kiosk has sold out.
exp.periodista_2.b: Buy her silence. Pricier this time.
exp.periodista_3.title: The exclusive
exp.periodista_3.body: Lucía Ferrán publishes dates, figures and a photo of you toasting with Fermín and Pórtico on a building site. The photo is very well framed.
exp.periodista_3.d: Wait for it to blow over.
